bunkers.name: Name
bunkers.delete_body: %s will be removed from the world and its scooters become free-standing.
bunkers.stock_body: How many scooters this bunker can still dispense. Docking a ride puts one back.
bunkers.delete_all_body: All %s bunkers will be removed from the world and their scooters become free-standing. This cannot be undone.

stations.empty: No charging stations yet. Place one.
stations.name: Name
stations.docks_hint: How much rail gets built: one dock per scooter, up to four.
stations.docks_body: Shortening the rail needs the removed docks to be empty.
stations.colour_body: Only the posts and the totem are painted, so the change is instant.
stations.colour_hint: Pick the paint this station wears.
stations.delete_body: %s will be removed from the world and the scooters docked in it become free-standing.
stations.delete_all_body: All %s charging stations will be removed and any docked scooters released. This cannot be undone.

scooters.empty: No scooters yet. Place one or spawn one at a bunker.
scooters.bulk_delete_body: Scooters on a ride are skipped.
scooters.spawn_on_me_hint: The scooter spawns where you stand and you get on it with the keys.
scooters.extras_box_hint: Staff can open any storage box; riders only open the one on the scooter they rent.

placing.hint: The panel hides while you place it and comes back when you confirm or cancel.

handling.baseline_hint: The file every profile builds on. Used when no profile is live.
handling.name: Name
handling.live_warning: Live profile: saving changes every scooter on the server straight away.
handling.not_live: Not live: saving stores it. Make it live to apply it to every scooter.
handling.baseline_readonly: This is the file itself. Create a profile to tune handling live.
handling.export_body: Paste this over data/handling.meta to make these values the permanent default. Players need to reconnect after the resource restarts.
handling.delete_body: Delete %s and its change history? If it is live, scooters go back to handling.meta.
handling.unsaved_switch: You have unsaved changes. Discard them and switch profile?
handling.not_previewing: Ride a scooter to feel changes before saving
handling.presets_hint: Plain-language dials. Each one sets the raw values below, which you can still fine-tune.
handling.no_run: Take a test ride to measure it.

TopSpeed.label: Top speed
TopSpeed.hint: Balances drive force against air drag so the scooter tops out here. Test ride to confirm.

Acceleration.label: Acceleration
Acceleration.hint: How hard it pulls away. Keeps the top speed you set.

Grip.label: Grip
Grip.hint: Tyre grip in corners and under braking.

Lean.label: Lean
Lean.hint: How far it leans into corners.

hud.title: Test ride
hud.back: Press %s to return to the editor

fInitialDriveForce.label: Drive force
fInitialDriveForce.hint: How hard the motor pushes. Raises acceleration and top speed.

fInitialDragCoeff.label: Air drag
fInitialDragCoeff.hint: Resistance that grows with speed. Higher means a lower top speed.

fInitialDriveMaxFlatVel.label: Gearing speed
fInitialDriveMaxFlatVel.hint: Speed the gearing is built for. Keep it above the real top speed so it does not cap it.

fDriveInertia.label: Throttle response
fDriveInertia.hint: How quickly the motor spins up. Higher is snappier.

fClutchChangeRateScaleUpShift.label: Upshift speed
fClutchChangeRateScaleUpShift.hint: How fast it changes up a gear.

fClutchChangeRateScaleDownShift.label: Downshift speed
fClutchChangeRateScaleDownShift.hint: How fast it changes down a gear.

fDriveBiasFront.label: Front-wheel drive share
fDriveBiasFront.hint: 0 drives only the rear wheel, 1 only the front.

fBrakeBiasFront.label: Front brake share
fBrakeBiasFront.hint: 0.5 is even. Higher leans on the front wheel.

fTractionCurveMax.label: Peak grip
fTractionCurveMax.hint: Grip before the tyres start to slide.

fTractionCurveMin.label: Sliding grip
fTractionCurveMin.hint: Grip left once they slide. Keep it a little under peak grip.

fTractionCurveLateral.label: Slip angle
fTractionCurveLateral.hint: How far the tyres can angle before grip drops off.

fTractionSpringDeltaMax.label: Tyre flex
fTractionSpringDeltaMax.hint: How much the tyres squash before gripping.

fLowSpeedTractionLossMult.label: Launch wheelspin
fLowSpeedTractionLossMult.hint: Wheelspin when pulling away. 0 is none.

fTractionLossMult.label: Off-road grip loss
fTractionLossMult.hint: Grip lost on grass, dirt and sand.

fSuspensionUpperLimit.label: Upward travel
fSuspensionUpperLimit.hint: How far the wheels move up.

fMass.label: Mass
fMass.hint: Weight in kg. Heavier feels planted but slower to react.

vecCentreOfMassOffset.label: Centre of mass
vecCentreOfMassOffset.hint: Shifts the balance point: x sideways, y forward, z up.

vecInertiaMultiplier.label: Rotational inertia
vecInertiaMultiplier.hint: Resistance to rolling, pitching and turning.

fRollCentreHeightFront.label: Front roll centre
fRollCentreHeightFront.hint: Height the front of the body rolls around.

fRollCentreHeightRear.label: Rear roll centre
fRollCentreHeightRear.hint: Height the rear of the body rolls around.

fPercentSubmerged.label: Float depth
fPercentSubmerged.hint: How deep it sits in water before floating, in percent.

fLeanFwdForceMult.label: Lean-forward push
fLeanFwdForceMult.hint: Extra push when the rider leans forward.

fLeanBakForceMult.label: Lean-back pull
fLeanBakForceMult.hint: Pull when the rider leans back.

fLeanFwdCOMMult.label: Lean-forward weight shift
fLeanFwdCOMMult.hint: How far weight moves forward when leaning forward.

fLeanBakCOMMult.label: Lean-back weight shift
fLeanBakCOMMult.hint: How far weight moves back when leaning back.

fMaxBankAngle.label: Max lean angle
fMaxBankAngle.hint: How far it can lean in a corner, in degrees.

fFullAnimAngle.label: Full lean pose angle
fFullAnimAngle.hint: Lean angle where the rider reaches the full lean pose.

fStickLeanMult.label: Steering lean
fStickLeanMult.hint: How much steering tips it over.

fBrakingStabilityMult.label: Braking stability
fBrakingStabilityMult.hint: Keeps it straight under hard braking.

fWheelieBalancePoint.label: Wheelie balance angle
fWheelieBalancePoint.hint: Angle where a wheelie balances, in degrees.

fStoppieBalancePoint.label: Stoppie balance angle
fStoppieBalancePoint.hint: Angle where a stoppie balances, in degrees.

fWheelieSteerMult.label: Wheelie steering
fWheelieSteerMult.hint: Steering while on the back wheel.

fBikeGroundSideFrictionMult.label: Body side grip
fBikeGroundSideFrictionMult.hint: Sideways friction when it slides on its side.

fBikeOnStandLeanAngle.label: Stand lean angle
fBikeOnStandLeanAngle.hint: How far it leans when parked.

fEngineDamageMult.label: Motor damage
fEngineDamageMult.hint: How quickly crashes damage the motor.

horn.label: Horn
horn.hint: What the horn key (E) plays on a scooter. No horn switches it off so the key does nothing.

handling.horn_no_scooter: Get on a scooter, or stand within 15 m of one, to hear the horn.

common.view_only_hint: You can look around, but changes need the edit permission.

rides.end_body: %s is billed for the minutes so far and the scooter docks if it is at a station.
rides.refund_body: %s%d goes back to %s. They have to be online.

settings.intro: Changes apply to the whole server straight away. Leave a value at its file default to keep using the config file.
settings.reset_body: Every live override is removed and the config file values apply again.

Rentals_UnlockFee.label: Unlock fee
Rentals_UnlockFee.hint: The one-time fare, charged when a ride starts. Extras are added on top.

Rentals_Account.label: Pay from
Rentals_Account.hint: Where ride fees are taken from.

Rentals_MaxRideMinutes.label: Maximum ride time
Rentals_MaxRideMinutes.hint: Longer rides are ended and billed automatically.

Rentals_LockIdle.label: Lock idle scooters
Rentals_LockIdle.hint: Parked scooters can only be ridden through the app.

Rentals_RentDistance.label: Unlock distance
Rentals_RentDistance.hint: How close a player must be to unlock a scooter.

Rentals_StationDistance.label: Bunker distance
Rentals_StationDistance.hint: How close a player must be to order from a bunker.

Rentals_DockDistance.label: Dock distance
Rentals_DockDistance.hint: Ending a ride this close to a bunker or station docks the scooter.

Rentals_NearbyRadius.label: App search radius
Rentals_NearbyRadius.hint: How far the phone app lists scooters and bunkers.

Battery_ChargePerMinute.label: Charge speed
Battery_ChargePerMinute.hint: Percent gained per minute at a station.

Battery_MinToRent.label: Minimum to rent
Battery_MinToRent.hint: Scooters below this cannot be unlocked.

Battery_FlatRecoverMinutes.label: Flat recovery time
Battery_FlatRecoverMinutes.hint: How long a flat scooter waits before the fleet collects it.

Battery_AdoptedLevel.label: Adopted scooter battery
Battery_AdoptedLevel.hint: Battery of a non-fleet scooter docked at a station.

Battery_Paid_Enabled.label: Charging costs money
Battery_Paid_Enabled.hint: Off: every docked scooter charges to full for free.

Battery_Paid_MinimumFee.label: Minimum charge fee
Battery_Paid_MinimumFee.hint: The smallest bill for any charge.

Battery_Paid_Step.label: Target step
Battery_Paid_Step.hint: The charge target moves in steps of this size.

Battery_Paid_RefundOnStop.label: Refund on stop
Battery_Paid_RefundOnStop.hint: Stopping early refunds the undelivered percent.

Battery_Paid_Account.label: Charging paid from
Battery_Paid_Account.hint: Where charging fees are taken from.

Bunkers_Stock.label: New bunker stock
Bunkers_Stock.hint: Scooters a freshly placed bunker starts with.

warnings.floating: Floating %s m above the ground — press Alt to drop it
